blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about long interleaved inputs, such as documents of many pages and collections of hundreds of images, but they are slow to start: on inputs of about 100K tokens, the prefill takes most of the wait for the first output token. A common approach prunes the input by scoring its tokens with the target model itself or with a small model of the same family that first writes an answer. However, this scoring takes much of the time that pruning saves. We find that the evidence for a question lies in a few whole units (images or paragraphs), and that a small hybrid model finds them with one attention head of an early layer, even at half image resolution. Based on these findings, we propose SkimPrefill, which lets the small hybrid model read the whole input first, up to that early layer, with images at half resolution. Most layers of the small hybrid model (Qwen3.5-0.8B) run in linear time, so this pass is short. SkimPrefill then ranks every unit with that head and gives the target the top units as an ordinary shorter prompt. One untrained selector serves targets of different model families. Extensive experiments on MMLongBench at 128K tokens, with 19 datasets of five task types, show the effectiveness of SkimPrefill. With 10% of the input tokens kept, SkimPrefill speeds up the prefill of Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3-VL-32B by 3.7 times, 11.6 time and 8.2 times while maintaining their average accuracy.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以解答关于长期互页输入的问题,例如许多页面的文档和数百个图像的收藏,但是它们起步缓慢:在大约100K个符号的输入上,预填需要等待第一个输出符号的大部分时间. 一种共同的方法通过标出其符号来冲压输入值与目标模型本身,或者用同一个家庭的小型模型首先写出一个答案. 然而,这一评分需要很多时间来节省开支。 我们发现,一个问题的证据存在于几个整体单元(图像或段落)中,一个小型混合模型发现它们有一个早期层的注意力头,甚至半图像分辨率. 基于这些发现,我们提出SkimPrefill(SkimPrefill),它让小混合模型首先阅读整个输入,直到早期的层,图像在半分辨率. 小杂交模型(Quen3.5-0.8B)的大部分层都是线性时间运行的,因此这个传球很短. SkimPrefilling随后将每个单位与该头进行排位,并给予目标最高单位作为普通较短的提示. 一个未经训练的选手为不同模范家庭的目标服务。 在128K令牌上对MMLong Bench进行了广泛的实验,共有19个数据集,共5个任务类型,显示了SkimPrefill的功效. 在保存了10%的输入符后,SkimPrefill在保持平均准确性的同时,加快了Qwen3.5-9B,Gemma-4-12B和Qwen3-VL-32B的预填.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-language models (VLMs) [ 1 , 12 , 31 ] answer questions about long interleaved inputs, such as documents of many pages [ 27 ] and collections of hundreds of images [ 46 , 47 ] , but respond slowly.
A key source of this delay is the prefill [ 22 ] , which passes every token of these inputs, up to 128K [ 46 ] , through every layer before the first output token.
However, a question usually depends on a small part of such an input.
Token pruning [ 5 , 58 , 53 , 60 ] therefore shortens the target’s prefill by dropping tokens that are redundant or that the answer does not need.
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型(VLMs)[1,12,31]回答关于长期互页输入的问题,例如许多页的文件[27]和数百张图像集[46,47],但反应缓慢.
这种延迟的一个关键来源是预填 [22],它传递这些输入的每个符号,最高可达128K [46],在第一个输出符号之前通过每个层.
然而,一个问题通常取决于这种投入的一小部分。
Token pruning [5, 58, 53, 60] 因此通过投放多余的或答案不需要的标语来缩短目标的预填时间.

blocks.en:
Most existing VLM pruning methods score the input with the target or with a small model of its family, but they keep individual or merged tokens [ 53 , 58 ] instead of a whole image or a whole paragraph ( Tab. 1 ).
FastV [ 5 ] ranks visual tokens by the attention of an early layer of the target and prunes them inside it.
This is cheap, but one early layer ranks tokens poorly at small budgets [ 60 ] .
The training-free form of FlexSelect [ 59 ] takes the attention of a deeper reference layer instead, so the target reads the whole input up to that layer before it selects.
Small-VLM-Guided Pruning (SGP) [ 60 ] lets a small model of the target’s family write an answer first and sums its attention over all layers.
IF-Prune [ 37 ] moves beyond this answer-driven attention: it fine-tunes a small model that scores each visual token in one pass and serves larger models of the same architecture.
SGP and IF-Prune pass token positions to the target, so their small models serve only targets of their own family.
blocks.zh:
大多数现有的VLM普鲁恩方法都用目标或家庭的小模型来评分输入,但它们保留了单个或合并的符号[53,58],而不是一个完整的图像或一个完整的段落(Tab. 1).
FastV [5] 通过目标早期一层的注意来排列视觉标志,并把它压在里面.
这是便宜的,但一个早期 排名差的符号 在小预算 [60]。
FlexSelect [59] 的无训练形式取而代之的是更深的参考层的注意,因此目标在选择之前读取整个输入到该层.
Small-VLM-Guided Pruning(SGP)[60] 让目标家庭的小模型先写一个答案,
IF-Prune [37] 移动超越了这种由答案驱动的注意:它微调了一个小模型,将每个视觉符号在一个通过中评分,为同一架构的更大的模型服务.
SGP和IF-Prune将象征性位置传递给目标,因此他们的小模型只服务于自己家庭的目标.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Methods that shorten a long input before or inside the target. Other families: the kept input can go to a target of another family.
blocks.zh: 表1:在目标之前或目标内部缩短长期投入的方法。 其他家庭:保留的投入可以去另一个家庭的目标.

blocks.en:
Keeping individual tokens in the state-of-the-art work breaks the evidence apart on long interleaved inputs. In Fig. 2 a, the kept tokens spread over most images and paragraphs, and words of the evidence are dropped.
On such fragments, the target also often thinks longer before it answers, which adds to the waiting time.
A good selector for such inputs should therefore be fast and accurate: it should cost much less than the prefill and keep the evidence whole.
blocks.zh:
在最先进的工作中保留个人的标志,打破了长期互留投入的证据。 以法义. 2a,保存的标志物分布在大多数图像和段落中,证据的文字被删除.
在这些片段上,目标在回答之前也常常会想得更久,这增加了等待时间.
因此,这类投入的优秀选择者应迅速和准确:其费用应大大低于预填费用,并保持全部证据。

blocks.en:
A central observation behind our method is that a small model can find the evidence that a large one needs.
This evidence lies in a few whole images or paragraphs, and an early layer of the small model already points to them.
One attention head of that layer ranks the needle image near the top almost as often as the best layer of a much larger model of the same family ( Fig. 1 ).
It does so even more often than the best layers of larger models from other families.
Motivated by this, we propose SkimPrefill ( Fig. 2 b), which lets the small hybrid model read the whole input first and stop at that layer.
The small model, which we call the selector, then scores every image and paragraph with that head and passes the top units to the target as an ordinary, shorter prompt.
blocks.zh:
我们方法背后的一个中心观察是,一个小模型可以找到一个大模型需要的证据.
这些证据存在于几个完整的图像或段落中,小模型早期的一层已经指向它们.
该层的一位注意力头将针头图像排列在顶部附近,几乎与同一家族一个更大得多的模型(图1)的最佳层一样频繁.
它这样做的频率甚至超过其他家庭最大的模型的最佳层次。
以此为动机,我们提出SkimPrefill(图2b),让小型混合模型先读整个输入,然后止于该层.
这个小模型,我们称之为选择器,然后用那个头对每个图像和段落进行评分,并将顶部单位作为普通的,较短的提示传递给目标.

blocks.en:
The selector is fast because it is small and stops at that early layer, and accurate because it keeps whole images and paragraphs ( Fig. 3 ), ranked by that head.
It runs only the first 8 of the 24 layers of Qwen3.5-0.8B [ 31 ] , most of which use linear attention, on images at half resolution.
On Qwen3-VL-32B, the selection takes 0.71 s, while the target needs 17.58 s to prefill the full input.
Its ranking of whole units keeps most of the evidence in the input ( Fig. 4 ), and every target then thinks less than with the full input.
blocks.zh:
选择器速度快,因为它是小的,停在那个早期的层,准确的因为它保留了整个图像和段落(图3),由那个头排列.
它只运行了Qwen3.5-0.8B [31] 的24层中的前8层,其中大部分使用线性关注,在图像上以半分辨率进行.
在Quen3-VL-32B上,选择需要0.71 s,而目标需要17.58 s来预先填充全部输入.
它对整个单位的排名保留了输入中的大部分证据(图4),然后每个目标都认为小于全部输入.

blocks.en:
With SkimPrefill, the target also runs in an unchanged serving engine such as SGLang [ 61 ] , since it receives an ordinary, shorter prompt.
FastV and SGP drop tokens inside the target and FlexSelect reads the attention of its reference layer, so each target model needs its own engine changes.
SkimPrefill needs them once, for its selector, which serves targets of other families as well.
Unlike IF-Prune [ 37 ] , our selector needs no training.
It needs only 50 synthetic documents, which share no text or image with the evaluation data, to find its head and a threshold.
Here we summarize our contributions: • We find that, on long interleaved inputs, keeping whole images and paragraphs instead of single tokens raises the accuracy of three different scorers ( Sec. 5.6 ). Single tokens break the evidence apart, and the target then thinks about as long as with the full input or longer ( Fig. 3 ). • We show that one attention head in an early layer of a small model finds the evidence almost as often as the best layer of a much larger model. • We propose SkimPrefill, which gives the target the whole images and paragraphs that the head above ranks highest as an ordinary, shorter prompt, so one selector serves targets of different families without training. • Extensive experiments on MMLongBench [ 46 ] at 128K tokens, with 19 datasets of five task types, show the effectiveness of SkimPrefill.
With 10% of the input tokens kept, it speeds up the prefill of three target models, Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3-VL-32B, by 3.7 × \times , 11.6 × \times and 8.2 × \times while maintaining their average accuracy ( Tab. 2 ).
blocks.zh:
与SkimPrefill一起,目标也运行在SGLang[61]等不变的服务引擎中,因为它收到一个普通,较短的提示.
FastV和SGP在目标内部投放令牌,FlexSelect读取其参考层的注意力,因此每个目标模型都需要自己的引擎变化.
SkimPrefiller需要他们一次,作为它的选择者,它也为其他家庭的目标服务。
与IF-Prune[37]不同,我们的选手不需要训练.
它只需要50个合成文件,它们与评价数据没有共享文本或图像,就可以找到它的头和一个门槛.
我们在此总结我们的贡献: 我们发现,在长时间的互页输入上,保留整个图像和段落而不是单一的记号提高三个不同记分者的准确性(第5.6节)。 单符打破证据,然后目标思考,只要有完整的输入或更长的时间(图3). 我们显示,一个小模型早期层的注意头部发现的证据几乎与更大的模型的最佳层一样频繁。 我们提出SkimPrefill(SkimPrefill),它赋予目标整个图像和段落,上面的头像作为普通的,较短的即时排位最高,所以一个选择者为不同家庭的目标服务,而没有经过训练. · MMLong Bench[46]在128K令牌上进行了广泛的实验,有19套5种任务类型的数据集,显示了SkimPrefill的有效性.
在保存了10%的输入符后,它加快了三个目标模型的预填,Qwen3.5-9B,Gemma-4-12B和Qwen3-VL-32B,以3.7××时,11.6×时和8.2×时的速度,同时保持其平均精度(Tab. 2).

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Table 1 compares the pruning methods closest to ours; SkimPrefill is the one that serves VLM targets of other families without training.
blocks.zh: 表1比较了与我们最接近的打压方法;SkimPrefill是服务于其他没有受过培训的家庭的VLM目标的方法。

blocks.en:
Most visual token reduction methods let the target decide what to drop.
FastV [ 5 ] , SparseVLM [ 58 ] and PyramidDrop [ 51 ] rank visual tokens by their attention at one or several layers of the target, and VisionZip [ 53 ] keeps the dominant tokens of the vision encoder and merges the rest.
GemFilter [ 35 ] selects text tokens with the early layers of an LLM, and FlexSelect [ 59 ] ranks video tokens with one reference layer of the target, or with a small selector trained to mimic it.
In all of them the vision encoder or the early layers of the target read the whole input.
Sparse-attention methods such as MInference [ 15 ] and MMInference [ 22 ] keep every token and speed up only the attention computation of the prefill.
KV-cache compression such as LOOK-M [ 43 ] drops or merges cached image tokens during the prefill, which saves memory and decoding time but not prefill time.
blocks.zh:
多数视觉符号还原方法让目标决定什么是下降.
FastV [5], SparseVLM [58] 和 PyramidDrop [51] 通过注意力在目标的一个或几个层次对视觉标志进行排序, VisionZip [53] 保留视觉编码器的主导标志并合并其余部分.
GemFilter [35] 选择带有LLM的早期层的文本符号,FlexSelect [59] 将视频符号排序为目标的一个参考层,或者使用一个训练有素的小型选择器来模仿.
在所有它们中,视觉编码器或目标早期层读取整个输入.
MInform [15] 和MMInform [22] 等Sparse-attention方法保留每个符号,只加快预填的注意计算.
KV-cache 压缩如 Look-M [43] 在预填时滴出或合并缓存的图像符号,可以节省内存和解码时间,但不会预填时间.

blocks.en:
SGP [ 60 ] and IF-Prune [ 37 ] select with a small model of the target’s family or architecture, LAST [ 52 ] scores visual tokens with a compact VLM, and VisCache [ 44 ] filters video keyframes with CLIP.
For text-only LLMs, LLMLingua [ 16 ] drops whole in-context examples and then tokens by the perplexity of a small model, LongLLMLingua [ 17 ] first ranks documents by the perplexity of the question given each document, and LLMLingua-2 [ 29 ] trains a token classifier.
SpecPrefill [ 25 ] keeps fixed-size blocks scored by every layer and head of a draft LLM, which can come from another family if the kept text is re-tokenized [ 40 ] .
Coarser units are also used in text: ChunkKV [ 26 ] keeps or drops the target’s cached tokens in chunks and CPC [ 24 ] removes whole sentences, since removing single tokens can break the context.
SkimPrefill selects whole images and paragraphs of an interleaved input for VLM targets, and ranks images and text in one pass with one head of an early layer.
With the same scores, these units give higher accuracy than single tokens and shorter reasoning ( Sec. 5.6 ).
blocks.zh:
SGP [60] 和IF-Prune [37] 使用目标家庭或架构的小模型选择,LAST [52] 以紧凑的VLM评分视觉符号,VisCache [44] 用CLIP过滤视频键框.
对于仅文本的LLMS,LLMLingua [16] 将整个文本中的例子丢弃,然后通过一个小模型的复杂度来表示符号,LongLLMLingua [17] 按每个文件给出的问题的复杂度对文件进行排序,LLMLingua-2 [29] 训练一个符号分类器.
SpecPrefill [25] 保留每层和LLM草案头部打出的固定大小块,如果保存的文本被重新切入[40],则可以来自另一个家族.
缩写单位也用于文本中: ChunkKV [26] 以块块保存或放下目标缓存的符号,CPC [24] 删除整个句子,因为删除单个符号可以打破上下文.
SkimPrefill为 VLM 目标选择一个互页输入的完整图像和段落,并将图像和文本排列在一张通过中,并带有一个早期图层的头部.
由于得分相同,这些单位给出的准确度高于单一的符号,并缩短推理(第5.6条).

blocks.en:
In LLMs, a fraction of the heads perform long-context retrieval [ 48 , 49 ] , and CompressKV [ 23 ] keeps the KV-cache entries they attend to.
ICR [ 6 ] and QRHead [ 56 ] re-rank passages by the query’s attention to them in an LLM, over all heads or a few, and in VLMs such heads attend to visual evidence and rank pages and regions [ 21 , 30 ] .
CAPS [ 62 ] fine-tunes a VLM and selects document pages with its best head, scoring each page on its own.
SkimPrefill uses one such head of a small model, without training, to choose another model’s input.
blocks.zh:
在LLMs中,一小部分头部执行长文本检索[48,49],而CompressKV[23]保留了他们所处理的KV-cache条目.
ICR [6] 和 QRhead [56] 重新排列了段落的顺序,通过一个LLM, 覆盖所有头部或少数头部, 在VLM中,这些头部注意视觉证据和排位页及区域[21,30]。
CAPS [62] 对一个VLM进行微调,并选择具有最佳头的文档页面,每个页面单独评分.
SkimPrefill在不经过训练的情况下,使用一个小模型的一个这样的头来选择另一个模型的输入.

blocks.en:
Vision-based multimodal RAG keeps whole pages or images chosen by a retriever that encodes each on its own, with one embedding per unit (GME [ 57 ] ) or one per patch (ColPali [ 11 ] , ColEmbed V2 [ 28 ] ).
M3DocRAG [ 8 ] uses ColPali, VisRAG [ 55 ] its own VLM-based retriever, and SV-RAG [ 4 ] an adapter of the answering VLM.
In contrast, the selector of SkimPrefill reads all units together in one pass, with a model not trained for retrieval. Section 5.6 compares it with GME, ColEmbed V2 and the image-text encoder SigLIP 2 [ 39 ] .
blocks.zh:
基于Vision的多式联运RAG保存完整页面或图像,这些页面或图像由自行编码的检索器选择,每个单元嵌入一个(GME [57])或每个补丁一个(ColPali [11],ColEmbed V2 [28]).
M3DocRAG [8] 使用ColPali,VisRAG [55] 其自己的基于VLM的检索器,以及SV-RAG [4] 作为应答VLM的适配器.
相比之下,SkimPrefill的选取者将所有单位一起读取为一张通行证,其中的模型没有经过检索训练. 第5.6节将其与GMEE,ColEmbed V2和图像文本编码器SigLIP 2 [39].

blocks.en: 3 What a fast and accurate selector needs
blocks.zh: 3个 快速准确的选手需要多少

blocks.en:
This section measures what a fast and accurate selector needs on interleaved inputs of about 100K tokens.
We find that most of the wait for the first token is the target’s prefill, the evidence for a question lies in a few whole units, and one early head of a small hybrid model finds these units at a fraction of the prefill’s cost.
blocks.zh:
本节衡量一个快速和准确的选定者在间隔约100K个令牌的输入上需要什么.
我们发现,等待第一个象征物的大部分是目标预填,一个问题的证据存在于几个整体单元中,一个小型混合模型的早期头目发现这些单元的成本是预填的一小部分.

blocks.en:
In Fig. 5 , an input of about 105K tokens on Qwen3-VL-32B waits 19.06 s for the first output token, of which 17.58 s is the target’s prefill.
On Qwen3.5-9B, the prefill takes 5.82 of the 7.19 s (see Appendix E ).
A selector that shortens the target’s input can remove most of this wait, as long as choosing what to keep costs much less than the prefill itself.
blocks.zh:
在图5中,在Quen3-VL-32B上输入约105K个令牌等待19.06s的第一个输出令牌,其中17.58s是目标预填.
在Quen3.5-9B上,预填需要7.19 s中的5.82(见附录E).
一个缩短目标输入的选手可以删除大部分的等待,只要选择将成本维持在比预填本身少得多的方面.

blocks.en:
The evidence for a question usually comes in whole units: an image, a page or a paragraph.
For example, to count objects or read a table, the target needs the whole image or page.
The data files of MMLongBench [ 46 ] mark the evidence of 928 of our test questions: needle images, needle sentences or answer pages.
This evidence is small: on average, up to 2.4% of the input tokens, depending on the task.
Even kept as whole units, it takes up at most 10% of the tokens for 922 of these questions. Figure 3 compares token-, block- and unit-level selection on Qwen3-VL-32B with 10% of the tokens.
Keeping the most important tokens also works well: the accuracy degradation of FlexSelect and SGP relative to the full input is up to 0.6 points.
However, the tokens that token-level methods [ 5 , 59 , 60 ] consider important are spread over most of these units and miss words of the evidence ( Fig. 2 a), and the target then generates about as many tokens per answer as with the full input or more.
SpecPrefill’s blocks of 32 tokens also lengthen the answers (2.9K against 1.9K tokens) and lower the accuracy by 6.5 points.
Keeping whole units instead makes the target generate fewer tokens than with the full input and answer more accurately.
A selector should therefore rank and keep whole units.
blocks.zh:
一个问题的证据通常以整个单位出现:一个图像,一个页面或一个段落.
例如,要计算对象或读取一个表格,目标需要整个图像或页面.
MMLong Bench的数据文件[46]标志着我们测试问题的证据928:针头图像,针头句或答页.
这种证据很小:根据任务的不同,平均高达输入符的2.4%.
即使保持整体单位,它也占用了其中922个问题的最多10%的代币. 图3比较了Qune3-VL-32B上的符号级,块级和单位级选择,与10%的符号比较.
保持最重要的标志也很好:FlexSelect和SGP相对于全输入的精度降解高达0.6分.
然而,象征级方法[5,59,60]认为重要的符号分布在大多数这些单位,并漏掉证据的文字(图2a),然后目标每个回答生成的符号大约与全部输入或更多.
SpecPrefill的32个令牌的块也延长了答案(2.9K对1.9K令牌),并将准确度降低6.5分.
相反,保持整个单位使得目标生成的代号少于全部输入和回答更准确的代号.
因此,挑选者应排队并保留整个部队。

blocks.en:
We find that an early head of a small hybrid model locates these units about as well as larger models, or better, and in less time ( Fig. 1 ).
On the image questions of MM-NIAH, a needle-in-a-haystack benchmark, head 7 of layer 7 of Qwen3.5-0.8B puts a needle among the top-ranked images for 94% of the questions, against 96% for the best layer of Qwen3.5-9B, 90% for Qwen3-VL-2B and 78% for the larger Gemma-4-12B.
It reaches that layer in 1.85 s, against 3.52, 3.13 and 21.36 s for these models.
At half resolution, which SkimPrefill uses, the rate is still 83%, in 1.30 s.
Earlier work shows that hybrid models with few attention layers do well on needle-in-a-haystack tests of long inputs [ 19 , 42 ] .
Layers with a fixed-size state retrieve exact content from the input less well than attention [ 14 , 54 ] , and hybrid models depend on their attention layers for retrieval [ 2 ] .
SkimPrefill picks its head on synthetic documents, as described in Sec. 4.2 .
blocks.zh:
我们发现,一个小型混合模型的早期头部将这些单元定位在大约以及更大的模型上,或者更好,在更少的时间内(图1).
关于MM-NIAH的图像问题,一个针入海斯塔克基准,Qwen3.5-0.8B的7层头部将针入94%的题材中排在顶级的图像中,而最佳层的Wen3.5-9B为96%,Qwen3-VL-2B为90%,较大的Gemma-4-12B为78%.
它在1.85s中达到该层,而这些型号则达到3.52,3.13和21.36s.
在SkimPrefiller使用的半解析度上,比例仍然是83%,在1.30s.
早期的研究表明,关注层很少的混合模型在对长投入的针入海斯塔克测试上表现良好[19,42].
具有固定大小状态的图层从输入中检索到准确内容不如注意[14,54],混合模型取决于它们的注意层进行检索[2].
如第4.2节所述,SkimPrefiller在合成文件中挑头。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
SkimPrefill lets a small hybrid model read the whole input before the target does.
The selector runs up to an early full-attention layer, scores every image and paragraph with one head there, and passes the highest-scoring units, as a whole, to the target as an ordinary, shorter prompt.

SkimPrefill让一个小混合模型在目标完成前读取全部输入.
选择器运行到一个早期的全注层,每个图像和段落的分数都有一个头在那里,并将最高的分数单位整体传递给目标,作为一个普通的,较短的即时.

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3.5-9B [ 31 ] , Gemma-4-12B [ 12 ] and Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking [ 1 ] , each with a 256K-token context window, as target models and compare SkimPrefill with four training-free pruning methods: FastV [ 5 ] , FlexSelect [ 59 ] , SGP [ 60 ] and SpecPrefill [ 25 ] .
FastV and FlexSelect rank tokens by the attention of one layer of the target, SGP by that of a small model of the target’s family that answers first (Qwen3.5-2B, Gemma-4-E2B and Qwen3-VL-2B), and SpecPrefill ranks 32-token chunks with the same small models.
For each question, FastV, FlexSelect and SGP keep as many single tokens as SkimPrefill, images and text alike, and SpecPrefill keeps the top 10% of its chunks; all four leave the kept tokens at their original positions.
blocks.zh:
我们使用 Quen3.5-9B [31], Gemma-4-12B [12] 和 Quen3-VL-32B- Thinking [1] , 每一个都有一个256K-token上下文窗口作为目标模型,并将 SkimPrefill 与四种无训练的穿插方法进行比较: FastV [5],FlexSelect [59],SGP [60] 和 SpecPreful [25].
FastV和FlexSelect通过目标一层的注意来排序符号,SGP通过目标家族中一个小模型先答(Quen3.5-2B,Gemma-4-E2B和Quen3-VL-2B),SpecPrefill用相同的小模型来排行32个托肯块.
对于每个问题, FastV, FlexSelect 和 SGP 都保留着像 SkimPrefill 一样的单一符号, 图像和文本都一样, SpecPrefill 保留其前10%的块; 所有四个都将保存的符号留在原位置.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on MMLongBench [ 46 ] at its longest length, 128K tokens, with 1,750 test inputs sampled from 19 datasets [ 7 , 20 , 45 , 47 , 18 , 3 , 41 , 50 , 13 , 34 , 10 , 27 , 38 ] in five categories: visual RAG (VRAG), needle in a haystack (NIAH), many-shot in-context learning (ICL), summarization (Summ) and long-document VQA (DocQA).
We report MMLongBench’s metric for each dataset (ROUGE-L F1 for summarization) and the mean of its category averages.

我们评价MMLong Bench[46]最长长度,128K令牌,从19个数据集[7,20,45,47,18,3,41,50,13,34,10,27,38]样本中抽取1,750个测试投入,分为5类:视觉RAG(VRAG),针头在干草堆(NIAH),多镜头的内文学习(ICL),概括(摘要)和长文件VQA(DocQA).
我们报告每个数据集的MMLong Bench的度量(用于汇总的ROUGE-L F1)及其类别的平均值。

blocks.en:
SkimPrefill uses one setting for every target: Qwen3.5-0.8B as the selector, with images at half resolution, and head 7 of layer 7 and the threshold τ = − 0.41 \tau=-0.41 from the synthetic documents of Sec. 4.2 .
The primary modality receives 3/4 of the budget ( α = 3 / 4 \alpha=3/4 ), a value we did not tune, the last W = 256 W=256 tokens of the document are always kept ( Sec. 4.3 ), and Q Q holds the last 32 prompt tokens and the tokens of any question image.
Every target reasons with its recommended sampling settings for at most 32K tokens before it answers, and runs in SGLang [ 61 ] on H100 GPUs, Qwen3-VL-32B on two with tensor parallelism.
Speed is the time to first token (TTFT) on 190 questions (10 per dataset) with batch size 1, image preprocessing and selection included; the selector runs on a separate H100, and on the target’s GPUs it gives about the same speedups (see Appendix E ).
For more details on the benchmark, the sampling settings and the baselines, see Appendices A and B .

在回答之前,每个目标原因都以其推荐的采样设置最多为32K个令牌,并以SGLang [61]运行在H100 GPU上,Quen3-VL-32B运行在两个具有拉伸并行性的上.

关于基准、取样设置和基线的详情,见附录A和B。

blocks.en: 5.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
With 10% of the input tokens ( Tab. 2 ), SkimPrefill speeds up the prefill of every target by 3.7–11.6 × \times and raises its average accuracy, the highest among the pruning methods on all three targets.
Both its speedup and its gain are largest on Gemma-4-12B (11.6 × \times ; 35.0 to 45.4), whose full input is slow in SGLang and often reaches the 32K limit ( Sec. 5.4 ).
Where neither the full input nor SkimPrefill reaches it, every target’s mean score still rises by 3.3 to 13.4 points (see Appendix D ).
Without reasoning, SkimPrefill stays 2.0 to 8.1 points above the full input on every target (see Tab. 8 in the appendix).
blocks.zh:
使用10%的输入符(Tab 2),SkimPrefill将每个目标的预填速度加快了3.7–11.6 ×\时间,并提升其平均准确度,是所有三个目标的普林方法中最高的.
在Gemma-4-12B(11.6 ×\times;35.0至45.4)上,其速度和收益都最大,其全输入在SGLang中速度缓慢,常达到32K极限(sec. 5.4).
如果完全投入和SkimPrefill都达不到,每个目标的平均分仍然上升3.3至13.4分(见附录D)。
没有推理,SkimPrefill在每一个目标的全部输入值上方保留2.0至8.1分(见附录中的Tab.8).

blocks.en:
Accuracy rises most on needle questions, by 10.9 to 26.1 points, where the evidence is a few images or sentences, and in visual RAG, by 2.0 to 7.5 points.
But accuracy falls by 3.4 to 4.2 points in summarization, which needs the whole document. Long-document VQA also falls on Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3-VL-32B, mainly on LongDocURL ( Sec. 5.7 ).
blocks.zh:
精确度在针头问题上上升最多,10.9至26.1分,其中证据为少数图像或句子,在视觉RAG中,精确度为2.0至7.5分.
但准确性在归纳上下降了3.4至4.2分,这需要整个文档. 长文件VQA也落在Qwen3.5-9B和Qwen3-VL-32B上,主要在LongDocURL上(5.7sec.

blocks.en:
FlexSelect and SGP average between 0.9 points below and 1.1 above the full input on Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3-VL-32B, at prefill speedups of 0.9–1.1 × \times and 1.1–2.1 × \times , since FlexSelect runs most of the target’s layers before it selects and SGP’s small model writes an answer ( Sec. 5.4 ).
FastV is faster, by 1.6–4.0 × \times , but falls more than 20 points below the full input on every target.
SpecPrefill falls 6.5 to 14.3 points below the full input, at 1.0–2.3 × \times .
blocks.zh:
FlexSelect和SGP在Wen3.5-9B和Quen3-VL-32B上的全部输入均值在0.9点到1.1点之间,预填速度为0.9–1.1×××时和1.1–2.1××时,因为FlexSelect在选择目标之前运行大部分层,SGP的小模型会写一个答案(第5.4节).
FastV更快,以1.6–4.0×x\times的速度,但比每个目标的全部输入低20多点.
SpecPrefile在全输入值下跌6.5至14.3分,为1.0–2.3×\times.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Annotated evidence tokens kept at a 10% budget (questions in parentheses).
blocks.zh: 图4:附加说明的证据符号,保留在10%的预算中(括号内为问题)。

blocks.en: 5.3 Evidence kept by each method
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 每种方法保存的证据

blocks.en:
Figure 4 measures how much of the annotated evidence each method keeps with 10% of the tokens.
SkimPrefill keeps most of it, with one input for every target: 97% of the needle-image tokens, 72% of the Visual Haystacks needles and 79% of the answer-page tokens.
FlexSelect and SGP keep 46–76% of these image and page tokens on Qwen3.5-9B and less on Gemma-4-12B, where token-level selection leaves a few patches of most images and fragments of most paragraphs.
SpecPrefill keeps 45–48% of them on Qwen3.5-9B and 22–54% on Gemma-4-12B.
On Gemma-4-12B, FastV and FlexSelect keep 6–10% of the Visual Haystacks needles and answer pages; FlexSelect’s kept tokens spread evenly over the document.
blocks.zh:
图4衡量每种方法有多少附加说明的证据保留了10%的代币。
SkimPrefill保存了大部分,每个目标都有一个输入:97%的针形符,72%的视觉海斯塔克斯针形符和79%的答页符.
FlexSelect和SGP在Quen3.5-9B上保留了这些图像和页面符的46–76%,在Gemma-4-12B上则更少,其中的符符级选择留下了大部分图像的几块补丁和大部分段落的片段.
SpecPrefill保留了其中的45–48%在Quen3.5-9B上,22–54%在Gemma-4-12B上.
在Gemma-4-12B上,FastV和FlexSelect保留了6-10%的视觉海斯塔克针头和答题页;FlexSelect保存的标语在文档上分布均匀.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Time to first token on Qwen3-VL-32B, split into preprocessing, selection and the target’s prefill; 190 questions of about 105K input tokens (SGLang, batch size 1).
blocks.zh: 图5:Qwen3-VL-32B上第一令牌的时间,分为预处理,选择和目标预填;约105K输入令牌的190个问题(SGLang,批量尺寸1).

blocks.en: 5.4 Speed of each method
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 每种方法的速度

blocks.en: Table 3 : Generation length at 10% of the input tokens (1,750 questions). Tokens : mean generated tokens, reasoning and answer; 32K : answers that reach the 32K reasoning limit.
blocks.zh: 表3: 输入符的10%(1 750个问题)的生成长度。 Tokens:指生成的符,推理和答案;32K:达到32K推理极限的答案.

blocks.en:
On Qwen3-VL-32B ( Fig. 5 ), SkimPrefill waits 2.33 s for the first token, against 19.06 s for the full input, since its selector stops at layer 7 of a 0.8B model and the target prefills only the kept units.
The baselines pay more for their selection: FlexSelect runs 49 of the target’s 64 layers over all 105K tokens (13.78 s), the small models of SGP and SpecPrefill read the whole input and both generate some tokens (4.52 and 4.72 s), and FastV, which selects inside the target, waits 4.71 s in all.
On all three targets, preprocessing and selection take 1.35–1.46 s, so the speedups of Tab. 2 grow with the target’s prefill time, up to 11.6 × \times on Gemma-4-12B, whose full input takes 34.05 s.
For more details, see Tab. 9 in the appendix.
blocks.zh:
在Qwen3-VL-32B(图5)上,SkimPrefiller为首个令牌等待2.33 s,而19.06 s为全输入,因为其选择器停止在0.8B型号的第七层,目标预填时只保留单元.
基准为选择这些基准付出了更大的代价: FlexSelect将目标64层中的49层贯穿所有105K令牌(13.78s),SGP和SpecPrefill的小模型读取了整个输入,同时生成一些令牌(4.52和4.72s),FastV则选择目标内部,总共等待4.71s.
在所有三个目标上,预处理和选择需要1.35–1.46 s,因此Tab的速度. 2随目标预填时间增长,在Gemma-4-12B上最多可达11.6×\时,其全输入需要34.05s.
详见Tab. 附录第9段。

blocks.en:
Every target answers in reasoning mode, so the wait for the answer also depends on how long it thinks.
In Tab. 3 , every target generates fewer tokens with SkimPrefill than with the full input and reaches the 32K limit less often, whereas token-level and block-level selection (SpecPrefill) make most targets think longer; Appendix D analyzes the answers of Gemma-4-12B that reach this limit.
From the request to the last answer token, SkimPrefill answers 2.2–3.8 × \times sooner than the full input, against 0.6–1.6 × \times for FastV, FlexSelect, SGP and SpecPrefill. Table 9 in the appendix splits this time into prefill and decoding.
blocks.zh:
每个目标在推理模式中都会回答,所以等待答案也取决于它思考的时间.
在 Tab. 3 中,每个目标与 SkimPrefill 生成的代号少于全部输入生成的代号,并且达到32K限制的频率较低,而符号级别和块级别选择(SpecPrefill)使得大多数目标思考的时间更长;附录D分析Gemma-4-12B达到这个限制的答案.
从请求到最后的答题符,SkimPrefill回答 2.2–3.8 ×\时间比全部输入要早,而FastV,FlexSelect,SGP和SpecPrefill的回答时间为0.6–1.6 ×\时间. 附录中的表9将这次分为预填和解码两种.

blocks.en: 5.5 Budget and input length
blocks.zh: 5.5 预算和投入长度

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Accuracy against prefill speedup at budgets of 5, 10 and 15% (labels), with the selector at half (ours) or full resolution.
blocks.zh: 图6:预填速度在预算为5、10和15%(标签)时的准确性,选择器为一半(我们)或完全分辨率。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Accuracy at three input lengths with 10% of the input tokens kept; above the bars of SkimPrefill: its prefill speedup.
blocks.zh: 图7:3个输入长度的精确度,保存10%的输入符;在SkimPrefill的条上方:其预填速度.

blocks.en:
A larger budget helps Qwen3-VL-32B and hurts Gemma-4-12B ( Fig. 6 ).
From 5% to 15%, the average of Qwen3-VL-32B rises by 4.0 points, mostly in long-document VQA (59.6 to 71.9; Tab. 15 ), where more pages hold more of the evidence, and that of Gemma-4-12B falls by 3.8 points but stays above the full input at every budget.
Its fall comes mostly from many-shot ICL, where its score drops from 46.0 to 18.3 (see Appendix G ).
blocks.zh:
更大的预算帮助 Qwen3-VL-32B并伤害Gemma-4-12B(图6).
从5%到15%,Qwen3-VL-32B的平均值上升了4.0点,大多在长文件VQA(59.6到71.9;Tab. 15)中,更多的页面持有更多的证据,Gemma-4-12B则下降了3.8点,但在每个预算中都高于全部投入.
它的衰落主要来自于许多镜头的ICL,其得分从46.0下降到18.3(见附录G.

blocks.en:
On the same questions at 32K and 64K tokens ( Fig. 7 ), the speedup grows with the input length on both targets, as the target’s prefill grows faster than the selector’s.
SkimPrefill stays above the full input at every length on Gemma-4-12B, and on Qwen3-VL-32B it falls 5.1 and 1.5 points below it at 32K and 64K, mostly in long-document VQA (60.5 against 81.3 at 32K, where 10% is about 3K tokens).
blocks.zh:
在32K和64K令牌(图7)的相同问题上,随着目标预填速度比选手的快,速度随两个目标的输入长度而增长.
SkimPrefill在Gemma-4-12B上每长停留在全部输入之上,在Quen3-VL-32B上,在32K和64K上,它下降5.1和1.5分,大部分在长文件VQA(60.5对81.3对32K,其中10%是约3K令牌).

blocks.en: 5.6 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.6 拖欠款项

blocks.en:
The selector reads every image at half resolution, since it only has to find the units that hold the evidence.
At a 10% budget, reading the original images changes the average by less than one point on every target (see Tab. 11 in the appendix), while halving them raises the speedup by 1.6–1.8 × \times .
blocks.zh:
选择者以半分辨率读取每个图像,因为它只需要找到持有证据的单位.
在10%的预算中,读取原始图像会改变每个目标的平均值不到一分(参见附录中的Tab 11),而将其减半则会提高1.6–1.8 ×\时速.

blocks.en:
With the same selector scores ( Tab. 4 ), keeping the highest-scoring tokens instead of whole units falls far below the full input on both targets (37.9 and 15.4) and makes both targets think longer than with whole units, and evenly spaced whole units stay below it (38.7 and 25.7).
Whole units matter more than their positions: tokens stay below the full input at consecutive positions, and whole units stay above it at their original positions.
The mean of all layer-7 heads ranges from 0.8 points below to 0.1 above SkimPrefill, while a random head falls to 50.2 and 34.6.
blocks.zh:
使用相同的选择器分数(Tab. 4),保持最高得分的符号而不是整个单位远远低于两个目标(37.9和15.4)的全部输入,使两个目标比整个单位的思考时间更长,平匀的空间整个单位保持低于它(38.7和25.7).
整个单位比其位置更重要:在连续位置上,标志停留在全部投入以下,整个单位在原位置上方.
所有第7层头的平均值从下面的0.8点到上面的0.1点,而随机头部则下降到50.2和34.6.

blocks.en:
We also apply our whole-unit selection to the scores of SGP and FlexSelect; it raises their accuracy over single tokens ( Tabs. 2 and 4 ), and on Qwen3.5-9B SkimPrefill is 1.3 and 1.2 points below them at a much lower cost.
Scoring with every full-attention head of the selector, following SpecPrefill, is less accurate and slower than SkimPrefill on both targets (53.0 against 62.7 on Qwen3.5-9B).
Larger selectors raise the average by up to 0.6 points but lower the speedup: the full-attention Qwen3-VL-2B lowers it more than the hybrid Qwen3.5-2B, although both run 12 layers (see Appendix F ).
blocks.zh:
我们还对SGP和FlexSelect的分数进行全单位选择;它提高了它们相对于单一符号(Tabs. 2和4)和Quen3.5-9B的精确度。 SkimPrefill(英语:SkimPrefill)低1.3分和1.2分,成本要低得多.
在SpecPrefill之后,与选手的每一个全注头进行比SkimPrefill在两个目标(Quen3.5-9B的53.0对62.7)都更准确和慢.
较大选手将平均值提升至0.6分但减速:全注Qwen3-VL-2B比杂交的Quen3.5-2B更低,虽然两者都运行12层(见附录F).

blocks.en: Table 4 : Ablations at 128K tokens, 10% kept (speedup as in Tab. 2 ; –: not measured); SkimPrefill keeps whole units at consecutive positions, and the last three rows rank all units in one list.
blocks.zh: 表 4: 128K 令牌的缩写, 10% 保留( 如 Tab 2 的速率; – : 未测量); SkimPrefill 将整个单位保留在连续位置, 最后三行将所有单位排在一个列表中 。

blocks.en:
A retriever can rank the units of SkimPrefill in place of the head, each unit against the question on its own ( Fig. 8 ).
SigLIP 2 [ 39 ] is about as fast but 5.4 points less accurate; ColEmbed V2 8B [ 28 ] and GME-2B [ 57 ] , which encode each image separately with a larger model, fall 0.3 and 1.5 points below SkimPrefill, at only 1.3 × \times and 1.6 × \times .
blocks.zh:
检索者可以将SkimPrefill的单位排在头部的位置,每个单位单独对质(图8).
SigLIP 2 [39] 大约快但5.4分不准确; ColEmbed V2 8B [28] 和 GME-2B [57] 分别用更大的模型编码每个图像,在SkimPrefill下跌0.3和1.5分,只有1.3××时和1.6×时.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Average accuracy against prefill speedup when a retriever replaces the head (Qwen3.5-9B, 10% kept); for SigLIP 2 and ColEmbed V2 8B, BM25 [ 33 ] ranks the paragraphs.
blocks.zh: 图8:回收器更换头部时预填速度的平均准确性(Quen3.5-9B,10%保留);SigLIP 2和ColEmbed V2 8B,BM25 [33]对段落进行排序.

blocks.en: 5.7 Failure analysis
blocks.zh: 5.7 失败分析

blocks.en: Table 5 : SkimPrefill on the 100 LongDocURL questions, whose documents at 128K tokens have 57 pages on average. Pages : pages kept; Missed : questions with no answer page kept.
blocks.zh: 表5:100个LongDocURL问题上的SkimPrefill,其128K令牌的文件平均有57页. 页面 : 页面保存; 错过 : 问题没有保存答案页.

blocks.en:
SkimPrefill falls behind SGP on LongDocURL, by 11.4 points on Qwen3-VL-32B and 14.5 on Qwen3.5-9B.
For 18 of the 100 questions, none of the pages that SkimPrefill keeps holds the answer ( Tab. 5 ), while SGP keeps a few tokens on nearly every page and answers most of these questions.
If SkimPrefill scored as well as SGP on these 18, its gap would shrink from 11.4 to 0.8 points, so the gap lies in the page ranking (see Appendix G ).
A 15% budget keeps an answer page for 6 of the 18 questions, but SkimPrefill stays 7.9 points below SGP at 10% on Qwen3-VL-32B.
blocks.zh:
SkimPrefill在LongDocURL上落后了SGP,在Quen3-VL-32B上落后了11.4分,在Quen3.5-9B上落后了14.5分.
对于100个问题中的18个,SkimPrefiller所保存的页面中没有任何一个持有答案(Tab. 5),而SGP则在几乎每一页都保留了几个符号,并回答了大多数这些问题.
如果SkimPrefiller和SGP在这18上得分,其差距将从11.4分缩小到0.8分,所以差距在于页面排名(见附录G.
15%的预算为18个问题中的6个问题保留了答案页,但SkimPrefill在Qwen3-VL-32B上保持7.9分低于SGP的10%.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : How the 1,750 outputs of Gemma-4-12B end with 10% of the input tokens kept; a broken output opens the reasoning tag again or ends without an answer.
blocks.zh: 图9:Gemma-4-12B的1,750个输出如何以保存10%的输入符结束;一个中断的输出再次打开推理标记,或者在没有答案的情况下结束.

blocks.en:
On Gemma-4-12B, all four baselines fall below the full input ( Tab. 2 ).
In Fig. 9 , only 11% and 8% of the outputs with FastV and FlexSelect give an answer (22% with SpecPrefill), against 72% with the full input and 85% with SkimPrefill.
Keeping single tokens explains most of the drop: with the same scores, whole units raise FlexSelect by 18.5 points and SGP by 16.4 ( Tabs. 2 and 4 ). Table 4 also shows that the head of SkimPrefill in Qwen3.5-0.8B, from another family, gives about the same accuracy as SGP’s Gemma-4-E2B, a small model of the target’s family (45.4 and 44.3), at 11.6 × \times instead of 1.2 × \times .
In many-shot ICL, token-level selection also splits the examples apart (see Appendix G ).
blocks.zh:
在Gemma-4-12B上,所有四个基线都低于全部输入(Tab. 2 ).
在图9中,只有11%和8%的FastV和FlexSelect给出一个答案(22%与SpecPrefill),而72%与全部输入,85%与SkimPrefill.
保持单音符解释大部分降分:用相同的分数,全单位将FlexSelect提高18.5分,SGP提高16.4分(Tabs. 2和4. 表4还显示,在Qune3.5-0.8B中SkimPrefill的负责人来自另一个家庭,给出的准确度与SGP的Gemma-4-E2B大致相同,Gemma-4-E2B是目标家庭的小型模型(45.4和44.3),为11.6×时,而不是1.2×时.
在许多shot的ICL中,符号级选择也会将实例分开(见附录G ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SkimPrefill, which builds on the finding that the evidence for a question lies in a few whole units.
A small hybrid model reads the input up to an early layer and ranks its units with one attention head of that layer; the target then prefills only the top-ranked units.
With a Qwen3.5-0.8B selector that needs no training, SkimPrefill keeps 10% of the input tokens and speeds up the prefill of three target models on MMLongBench at 128K tokens by 3.7–11.6 × \times while maintaining their average accuracy.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了SkimPrefill,它基于以下结论:一个问题的证据存在于几个单元。
一个小的混合模型读取输入到一个早期的图层,并用该图层的一个注意力头来排列它的单位;然后目标只预先填充排名最高的单位.
SkimPrefill使用一个不需要训练的Quen3.5-0.8B选择器,保留了10%的输入符,并在保持平均准确性的同时,以3.7–11.6×\时速加快在MMLong Bench上以128K令牌预填三个目标模型.

blocks.en: Appendix A Benchmark
blocks.zh: 附录A 基准

blocks.en:
We sample 1,750 test inputs from MMLongBench at 128K tokens.
They come from 19 datasets in five categories: visual RAG (InfoSeek [ 7 ] and ViQuAE [ 20 ] ), needle in a haystack (the text and image versions of three MM-NIAH tasks [ 45 ] and two Visual Haystacks tasks [ 47 ] ), many-shot in-context learning (Cars196 [ 18 ] , Food101 [ 3 ] , iNat2021 [ 41 ] and SUN397 [ 50 ] ), summarization (GovReport [ 13 ] and Multi-LexSum [ 34 ] ) and long-document VQA (LongDocURL [ 10 ] , MMLongBench-Doc [ 27 ] and SlideVQA [ 38 ] ).
MMLongBench’s overview table lists 16 datasets, since it counts the two versions of each MM-NIAH task as one.
Each MM-NIAH image task has 50 inputs, built from 18 to 26 distinct questions, each MM-NIAH text task 100 questions (MMLongBench itself samples 50), and every other dataset 100 questions.
Datasets that place the evidence at several depths of the input contribute one depth per question; on Visual Haystacks (single), MM-NIAH retrieval (text) and ViQuAE, this depth is the start of the input.
blocks.zh:
我们抽取了MMLong Bench的1 750个测试输入值128K。
它们来自19个数据集,分为5类:视觉RAG(InfoSeek [7]和ViQuAE [20]),针头在干草堆中(三个MM-NIAH任务的文字和图像版本[45]和两个视觉海斯塔克任务的文字和图像版本[47]),多镜头的编译学习(Cars196 [18],Food101 [3],iNat2021 [41]和SUN397 [50]),汇总(GovReport [13]和Multi-LexSum [34])和长文件VQA(LongDocurL [10],MMLong Bench-Doc [27]和SlipetVQA [38]).
MMLong Bench的概览表列出了16个数据集,因为它把每个MM-NIAH任务的两个版本算为一个.
每个MM-NIAH图像任务有50个输入,由18个至26个不同的问题组成,每个MM-NIAH文本任务有100个问题(MMLong Bench本身为50个样本),所有其他数据集有100个问题.
将证据置于输入数深度的数据集每个问题贡献一个深度;在Visual Haystacks(单),MM-NIAH reference(文本)和ViQuAE上,这个深度是输入的开始.

blocks.en:
As in MMLongBench, the two versions of each MM-NIAH task are averaged first, so the needle category averages five scores: the three MM-NIAH tasks and the two Visual Haystacks tasks.
MM-NIAH counting uses MMLongBench’s metric, which compares the sum of the listed counts with the sum of the annotated counts instead of MM-NIAH’s position-wise soft accuracy, so dropping an image without a needle does not change the score.
For summarization, we report ROUGE-L F1 in place of MMLongBench’s GPT-4o-based score.
blocks.zh:
和MMLong Bench一样,每个MM-NIAH任务的两个版本都是平均第一,因此针类平均得分5分:三个MM-NIAH任务和两个视觉海斯塔克任务.
MM-NIAH的计数使用MMLong Bench的度量衡,该度量衡将列出的计数总和与附加说明的计数总和进行比较,而不是MM-NIAH的姿势偏软的精度,因此没有针的投影不会改变计分.
在总结时,我们报告ROUGE-L F1取代了MMLong Bench的GPT-4o分数。

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation details
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: B.1 Targets and generation
blocks.zh: B.1 目标和生成

blocks.en: Qwen3.5-9B [ 31 ] combines Gated DeltaNet layers with full-attention layers, Gemma-4-12B [ 12 ] combines sliding-window layers with global attention layers, and Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking [ 1 ] uses full attention in all layers, according to its released configuration.
blocks.zh: Quen3.5-9B [31] 组合 三角洲 带全注层的网层,Gemma-4-12B [12] 将滑窗层与全球关注层结合,而Qune3-VL-32B-Thinking [1] 根据其释放的配置,在所有层中使用全注.

blocks.en:
Every target answers in its reasoning mode, in SGLang for every method, and all methods use the same sampling seed for a given question.
For accuracy, the targets run with SGLang’s deterministic inference.
Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma-4-12B turn on the thinking mode of their own chat templates, and Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking always reasons.
Sampling uses the recommended values: temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.95, and top-k 64 for Gemma-4-12B and 20 for the Qwen targets.
The reasoning may take up to 32,768 tokens.
If it has not ended by then, we append the end-of-reasoning tag: </think> for the Qwen targets and <channel|> for Gemma-4-12B, which reasons between <|channel>thought and <channel|> .
The Qwen targets then write their answer in at most 512 tokens (1,536 for summarization), and Gemma-4-12B, after a forced tag, in at most 1,024.
Only the answer is scored.
We also run every target without reasoning ( Appendix D ).
blocks.zh:
每个目标在其推理模式中回答,在SGLang中回答每个方法,所有方法都为特定问题使用相同的采样种子.
准确的说,目标以SGLang的决定性推论运行。
Quen3.5-9B和Gemma-4-12B打开自己聊天模板的思维模式,而Quen3-VL-32B-Thinking总是有原因的.
采样采用推荐值:气温1.0和最高0.95,Gemma-4-12B和Quen目标为20。
推理可能需要多达32,768个令牌.
如果到那时它还没有结束,我们附上Quen目标的结尾标记:</think>和Gemma-4-12B的<channel},这是QQChannel>想法和<channel}之间的原因。
Quen目标随后以最多512个令牌(1,536个总称)写出答案,Gemma-4-12B在强制标记后,以最多1024个表示.
只有答案才有分数。
我们还在没有推理的情况下管理每个目标(附录D)。

blocks.en: B.2 Experimental settings
blocks.zh: B.2 实验设置

blocks.en:
Every target answers in SGLang with the prompts, sampling settings, reasoning limits and seeds of Sec. B.1 .
For accuracy, the scores that choose the kept tokens are computed in PyTorch for the selector and for the baselines, except FastV, which ranks the tokens inside the target in SGLang.
For timing, every step runs in SGLang, except the retrievers of Appendix F , which are timed in their scoring runs.
The selector of SkimPrefill halves the image size with PIL’s bicubic filter on 16 CPU threads, and this step counts as preprocessing.
blocks.zh:
每个目标在SGLang中以Sec.B.1的提示,采样设置,推理极限和种子来回答.
为精确起见,选择保存的符号的分数在PyTorch中为选择器和基线计算,但FastV除外,FastV在SGLang中为目标内部的符号排序.
对于计时,每一步都运行在SGLang中,除了附录F的检索者,在他们的计分运行中计时.
SkimPrefill 选择器在 16 个 CPU 线程上用 PIL 的双立方过滤器将图像大小减半, 此步骤算作预处理 。

blocks.en:
Text is split into paragraph units at blank lines and at images.
An image unit is an image together with the short label lines next to it ( Sec. 4.1 ).
A piece of text with fewer than 8 tokens is not a unit; it is kept only as part of an image’s label or of the last W W tokens.
The score s i s_{i} of an image unit ( Sec. 4.2 ) uses only its visual tokens, not its label.
blocks.zh:
文本在空白行和图像中分为段落单位。
一个图像单元是一个图像,与其旁边的短标签线(Sec 4.1 .
少于8个符号的文字不是单位;它只作为图像标签或最后W W 符号的一部分保存。
一个图像单元(sec.4.2)的得分s i s_{i}只使用其视觉符号,而不是其标签.

blocks.en:
In their papers, FastV, FlexSelect and SGP rank only visual tokens and SpecPrefill only text; here all four rank every document token, images and text alike.
FastV, FlexSelect and SGP keep the instruction and the question and fill the rest with document tokens, so that the target prefills as many tokens as with SkimPrefill (about 10% of the document).
SpecPrefill keeps the top 10% of its chunks, and the four baselines leave the kept tokens at their original positions.
blocks.zh:
在他们的论文中,FastV,FlexSelect和SGP只排列视觉符号,SpecPrefill只排列文字;这里所有四个都排列每个文档符号,图像和文字都相同.
FastV,FlexSelect 和 SGP 保留指令和问题,并用文档符填充其余部分,这样目标预填的符号就和SkimPrefill一样多(约占文档的10%).
SpecPrefill保留其前10%的块,四个基线将保存的标志留在原位置.

blocks.en: B.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: B.3 基线

blocks.en: We compare only with scorers that need no training, as SkimPrefill needs none, and leave out IF-Prune [ 37 ] , which trains a small model that must share the target’s architecture, CAPS [ 62 ] , which fine-tunes a VLM to rank pages, and FlexSelect’s lightweight selector [ 59 ] , which is trained to mimic the ranking of the target’s reference layer.
blocks.zh: 我们只比较不需要训练的计分员, 因为SkimPrefill不需要任何训练, 并省略IF-Prune[37],

blocks.en:
We follow the training-free form of FlexSelect [ 59 ] and its official code: at one reference layer of the target, each document token scores the largest attention it receives from the tokens after the document, over all heads, and the whole document is ranked at once, with no frame groups.
We choose this layer with a needle test, as FlexSelect does, on 100 MM-NIAH image questions outside the test set: among the layers that attend to the whole input, we take the one whose top 10% of tokens holds the most needle-image tokens, namely layer 19 of Qwen3.5-9B (recall 0.66), layer 5 of Gemma-4-12B (0.50; layer 29: 0.28) and layer 49 of Qwen3-VL-32B (0.69).
In Fig. 1 , where one head ranks whole images, the best layers are 29 and 11.
blocks.zh:
我们遵循 FlexSelect [59] 的无训练形式及其官方代码:在目标的一个参考层,每个文档符记分从文件符记中得到的最大注意,在所有标题上,整个文档都是一次排列,没有帧组.
我们用针头测试来选择这个层,就像FlexSelect一样,在测试组外的100 MM-NIAH图像问题上:在关注整个输入的层中,我们选择一个拥有最多针头图像符号的前10%的代号,即Quen3.5-9B的第19层(回顾0.66),Gemma-4-12B的第5层(0.50;第29层:0.28)和Quen3-VL-32B的第49层(0.69).
在图1中,一个头排列整个图像,最好的层是29和11.

blocks.en:
SGP is the token-pruning part of SGL [ 60 ] without its early exit, and we follow its official code: the small model of the target’s family answers first, greedily, each document token scores the attention it receives from the question and the generated tokens, summed over heads, steps and layers, and the target drops the low-scoring tokens at layer 2, as in SGL’s lowest-retention setting.
We let the small model answer without reasoning in at most 64 tokens on every dataset (SGL’s code sets 10 or 100 per dataset).
blocks.zh:
SGP是SGL [60] 的标志性推算部分,没有提前退出,我们遵循它的官方代码: 目标家庭答案的小型模型首先贪婪地,每个文件的标分从问题得到的注意和生成的标分,在头部,阶梯和层次上概括,目标在第二层降下低分的标分,就像SGL的最低保留设置一样.
我们让小模型在每套数据集(SGL的代码集10或每套数据集100)最多64个符号中不作推理地回答。

blocks.en:
FastV [ 5 ] ranks the tokens at one layer by the attention of the last prompt token, averaged over heads, as in its official code (the paper uses the average attention a token receives), and the target drops the rest from the next layer on.
We rank once on the prompt, as in its KV-cache version.
Qwen3-VL-32B ranks at layer 1 (FastV’s K = 2 K=2 ); Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma-4-12B rank at their first layer that attends to the whole input, layer 3 after Gated DeltaNet layers and layer 5 after sliding-window layers.
blocks.zh:
FastV [5] 以最后一个即时指示牌的注意程度,将指示牌排列在一层,平均在头上,如在其官方代码中(纸张使用指示牌得到的平均注意),目标从下一层上放下其余的.
我们排了一次,就像它的 KV-cache 版本。
Quen3-VL-32B (英语). 排名为第一层(FastV的K = 2 K = 2); Quen3.5-9B 和 Gemma-4-12B 排名为第一层, 排名为整个输入, 第3层为Gated DeltaNet层之后, 第5层为滑窗层之后。

blocks.en:
The released code of SpecPrefill [ 25 ] has speculators only for Llama targets, so we use SGP’s small models (Qwen3.5-2B, Gemma-4-E2B and Qwen3-VL-2B) and take the attention of their full-attention layers only: the six of Qwen3.5-2B, the global layers of Gemma-4-E2B and all layers of Qwen3-VL-2B.
As in the released code, the last prompt token and up to 7 generated tokens attend to the prompt, the attention is smoothed over 13 tokens, maximized over layers and heads and averaged over these queries, and the target reads the top 10% of the chunks of 32 consecutive tokens.
We generate these tokens greedily, as the SpecPrefill paper does in its evaluations, since sampling them at the target’s temperature of 1 would make the selection random.
We chunk the image tokens, at full resolution, in prompt order like text, because the released code handles only text.
blocks.zh:
SpecPrefill [25] 的发布代码只针对Llama目标进行投机,因此我们使用SGP的小型模型(Quen3.5-2B,Gemma-4-E2B和Quen3-VL-2B),并且只注意其全心全意的层:Quen3.5-2B的六层,Gemma-4-E2B的全局层和所有层的Quen3-VL-2B.
和发布代码一样,最后一个即时符和最多7个生成的符符关注符关注符,注意力在13个符符上平滑,在层和头上最大化,并在这些查询上平均,目标读取了32个连续符符符的前10%.
正如Spec prefiller文件在评估中所做的那样,我们贪婪地生成这些符号,因为如果在目标温度为1时进行取样,选择就会是随机的。
我们像文字一样,将图像符号按完全解析度进行拼凑,因为所发布的代码只处理文字。

blocks.en:
In Fig. 8 , three retrievers, SigLIP 2, ColEmbed V2 8B and GME-2B, replace the head of SkimPrefill; only the unit scores change.
They rank the units of SkimPrefill, a full-resolution image with its label lines or a paragraph, and fill the same token budget.
Their image and text scores are not on one scale, so each question keeps the primary modality that SkimPrefill chose for it, and with it the split of the budget.
Their times leave out the selector’s pass that makes this choice, which favors them.
Each query is the question part of the prompt with its images.
blocks.zh:
在图8中,三个检索器SigLIP 2,ColEmbed V2 8B和GME-2B,取代SkimPrefill的主管;只有单位分数变化.
他们对SkimPrefill的单位进行排序,一个带有其标签线或段落的全分辨率图像,并填充同样的符号预算.
他们的图像和文本分数不是在一个尺度上,因此每个问题都保留了SkimPrefiller为它选择的主要模式,并以此来分割预算.
他们的时代留下了选择者的通行证,
每一个查询都是提示与其图像一起的问题部分.

blocks.en:
SigLIP 2 (so400m, 384 pixels) scores an image unit by the higher of its cosine similarities with the question text and with each question image, and reciprocal rank fusion [ 9 ] ( k = 60 k=60 ) combines this ranking with the BM25 ranking of the unit’s label against the question text.
ColEmbed V2 encodes an image unit, the image with its label, as one multi-vector document and scores it against each query separately: every query token takes its highest similarity over the document’s tokens, and these are averaged over the query’s tokens.
The queries are the question text and each question image, encoded as an image document; the unit keeps the highest of these scores.
blocks.zh:
SigLIP 2(so400m,384像素)通过它的余弦与问题文本和每个问题图像的高度相似度来评分一个图像单元,对等的排名组合[9](k = 60 k = 60)将这一排名与该单位的标签相对于问题文本的BM25排名结合起来.
ColEmbed V2 将一个图像单元,即带有其标签的图像编码为多向量文档,并按每个查询分别进行评分:每个查询符都取其最高的相似度来代替文档的符号,这些符号均取查询符的平均值.
查询是问题文本和每个问题图像,编码为图像文档;单位保存这些分数中最高的.

blocks.en:
Since ColEmbed V2 accepts a document only with an image and SigLIP 2 reads only 64 text tokens, BM25 [ 33 ] ranks the paragraphs against the question text for both.
In VRAG, where the question image is the only image, both also rank the passages against this image and fuse this ranking with that of BM25 in the same way: SigLIP 2 by the cosine similarity of a passage’s first 64 tokens with the image, ColEmbed V2 by late interaction of the passage, encoded as a query of up to 512 tokens, with the image.
blocks.zh:
由于ColEmbed V2只接受带有图像的文档,而SigLIP 2只读了64个文本符号,BM25 [33]将这两段与问题文本相对排列.
在VRAG中,问题图像是唯一的图像,两者也都根据这个图像对段落进行排序,并以同样的方式将这个排名与BM25的排名连接: SigLIP 2,由一段前64个符号与图像的同位素相似性,ColEmbed V2通过一段的晚期交互,编码为高达512个符号的查询,与图像.

blocks.en: GME-2B embeds every unit as one vector, and the question once with each of its images under the instruction “Find an image or a passage that helps answer the question.”; each unit is ranked by its highest cosine similarity with these query vectors.
blocks.zh: GME-2B将每个单元嵌入为一个向量,这个问题在指令"寻找一个图像或一个通道来帮助回答问题"下与每个单元的图像一次嵌入;每个单元按照与这些查询向量的最高同位素相似性排序.

blocks.en: B.4 Variants in Tab. 4
blocks.zh: B.4 Tab中的备选案文。 页:1

blocks.en:
Top tokens at original positions keep each token at its position in the full prompt; at consecutive positions, the kept tokens are numbered one after another.
Whole units at original positions give the target SkimPrefill’s short prompt with each token at its position in the full prompt.
The blank line that SkimPrefill inserts between two kept units takes the position right after the last token of the unit before it.
blocks.zh:
原始位置上方的标志物将每个标志物按其位置全速保存;在连续位置上,保存的标志物逐个编号.
SkimPrefill在最初位置的全体单位,
SkimPrefill在两个保留单元之间插入的空白线紧接该单元的最后一个符号。

blocks.en:
The row “All layers, as in SpecPrefill” of Tab. 4 replaces the head of SkimPrefill with SpecPrefill’s scoring ( Sec. B.3 ): the selector reads the images at half resolution, runs all 24 layers and scores each token by the attention that the last prompt token and up to 7 greedy generated tokens pay to it in its 6 full-attention layers.
A unit’s score is the mean over its tokens, and all units are ranked in one list, as in the rows with SGP’s and FlexSelect’s scores.
Running all 24 layers lowers the speedup from 3.7 × \times to 3.1 × \times on Qwen3.5-9B and from 11.6 × \times to 10.0 × \times on Gemma-4-12B ( Tab. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
标签的“各层”一行。 4用SpecPrefill的评分(Sec. B.3)取代SkimPrefill的首字母:选择者以半分辨率读取图像,运行全部24层,并按每个符号进行评分,其注意度是最后一个即时符号和最多7个贪婪生成的符号在它的6个全注层中支付给它的.
一个单位的得分是其标志的平均值,所有单位的得分都排在一个列表中,如在SGP和FlexSelect的得分排行中.
运行所有24层将速度从3.7×\时降低到3.1×时,运行于Quen3.5-9B时,运行于11.6×时,运行于Gemma-4-12B时,运行于10.0×时(Tab. 4).

blocks.en: Appendix C Calibration documents
blocks.zh: 附录C 校准文件

blocks.en:
We choose the selector’s head and its threshold τ \tau ( Secs. 4.2 and 4.3 ) on 50 synthetic documents that share no text or image with MMLongBench.
Each document starts with the instruction “Read the document below, which mixes text and pictures, and answer the question at the end.” and ends with a question.
Between them are consecutive paragraphs of PG-19 [ 32 ] books, 393 to 2,701 per document, and 64 pictures from nine MileBench [ 36 ] subsets (nuScenes, ALFRED, TQA and six video-frame subsets) at random paragraph boundaries.
Paragraphs are added until the document reaches about 108K Qwen3.5 tokens (107,601 to 108,064), close to the MM-NIAH image documents of the 128K setting (108K to 111K tokens).
Every paragraph and picture is used once in the whole set, a document holds at most one frame of a video, and pictures are shrunk to a long side of at most 768 pixels.
A paragraph is dropped when any of its 13-word windows occurs in an MMLongBench data file (43 of 109,723 paragraphs).
A picture is dropped when it equals or nearly duplicates one of the 269,945 MMLongBench images; none did.
blocks.zh:
我们在与MMLong Bench没有文本或图像的50份合成文件中选择选择选手的头部及其阈值\tau(第4.2和4.3节)。
每个文件以“阅读下面的文档,将文本和图片混在一起,并在结尾回答问题”开头,最后是提问。
它们之间有PG-19[32]书的连续段落,每份文件393至2,701段,以及随机段落边界的9 Mile Bench [36]子集(nuScenes,ALFRED,TQA和6个视频帧子集)的64张照片.
在文件达到约108K Quen3.5令牌(107,601至108,064)之前,增加段落,接近128K设定的MM-NIAH图像文件(108K至111K令牌).
每个段落和图片在整集中都使用一次,文档最多持有一个视频框,图片缩到一个长边,最多768像素.
当一个MMLong Bench数据文件(109 723段中的43段)中出现其13个字窗口时,将删除一个段落。
当一张照片等于或几乎重复269 945 MMLong Bench 图像之一时,就会丢弃;没有。

blocks.en:
Each document carries one image needle, a book cover from the OCR-VQA subset of MileBench, in one of three kinds: pasted into one picture (17 documents), pasted into two or three pictures (17) or inserted as a picture of its own (16).
For the first and the last kind, the question shows four covers and asks which one is in the document; for the second, it asks how many copies each picture holds.
Each cover, as needle or option, is used once (149 in all).
A second copy of each document drops the image question and its option images and adds text needles, sentences appended to randomly chosen paragraphs, with a question about them.
The text needle is a fact asked in other words (17 documents), two to four counts to be listed (17) or two facts to be combined (16).
An example of the first kind is “The choir of Tallinn rehearses in a converted grain store.”, asked as “In what kind of building does the singing group of Tallinn practise?”
The needle sentences are our own and share no 6-word window with MMLongBench.
blocks.zh:
每份文件都带有一个图像针,一个书封,来自Mile Bench的OCR-VQA子集,分为三种类型之一:粘贴成一张图片(17份文件),粘贴成两三张图片(17张),或作为自己的图片插入(16张).
对于第一种和最后一种,问题显示四个封面,并询问文档中哪个封面;对于第二个封面,它询问每张照片有多少份。
每一个封面,作为针头或选择,一次使用(共149个).
每个文档的第二个副本放下图像问题及其选项图像,并添加文本针,句子附在随机选择的段落上,并附有关于它们的疑问.
文字针是换句话说(17份文件)询问的事实,要列出2至4项罪状(17项)或两个事实合并(16项).
第一种例子是“塔林的合唱团在一个转换后的谷物店排练”,被问到“塔林的歌唱团体在何种建筑中练习? “
针句是我们自己的 和MMLong Bench没有6字的窗口

The selector scores each unit by the attention that the question pays to it in one head of one layer ( Sec. 4.2 ).
To choose this head, we leave out the text units within 256 tokens of the question and count, for each head, the questions whose three highest-scoring units hold the needle.
The head with the most image questions wins; ties go to more text questions and then to the earlier layer. Table 6 gives, for each full-attention layer of the selector, the head whose three highest-scoring units hold a needle for the most questions.
We use head 7 of layer 7.
Its top three units hold the needle for all 50 image questions, which no other head reaches, and for 31 of the 50 text questions, against 25 to 38 for the other layers.
This head is not the best one for text needles: layer 11 finds more of them, but the selector would then run 12 layers instead of 8, so we trade these few text needles for a shorter selector pass.

Section 5.2 makes two statements about the 32K reasoning limit: Gemma-4-12B’s full input often reaches it, and SkimPrefill still raises every target’s mean score on the questions where neither the full input nor SkimPrefill reaches it.
This paragraph gives the numbers behind both.
With the full input, 435 of the 1,750 answers of Gemma-4-12B reach the 32K reasoning limit, and 356 of them are wrong.
The capped answers score 18.4 on average, against 39.3 for the others.
With SkimPrefill, 266 answers reach the limit.

blocks.en:
On the 1,161 questions where neither run reaches it, SkimPrefill raises the mean score from 42.2 to 55.6.
The gain holds in four categories: from 55.0 to 56.3 in visual RAG, from 48.8 to 80.4 in needle in a haystack, from 1.9 to 27.9 in many-shot ICL (154 questions) and from 62.6 to 63.5 in long-document VQA.
Summarization falls from 22.6 to 18.8.
So many-shot ICL stays low with the full input even when the reasoning ends.

总结从22.6降至18.8。
因此,许多镜头的ICL即使推理结束,仍然保持了完全输入的低水平.

blocks.en:
All times are means over the 190 timing questions, each measured on the first request for its input.
A method’s time to first token is the sum of Before and Prefill in Tab. 9 , and its speedup in Tab. 2 is the full input’s time to first token divided by the method’s.
SGLang runs the Qwen targets with FlashAttention-3 and Gemma-4-12B with the Triton backend, the only SGLang backend in which Gemma’s image tokens attend to each other in both directions.
For the Qwen targets, we run the image processor before the request and time it as preprocessing; Gemma-4-12B’s images go to SGLang as they are, and SGLang processes them while handling the request. Table 9 therefore counts this step in Prefill , or in Before for FlexSelect, SGP and SpecPrefill, whose scoring passes run in SGLang too.
FlexSelect’s selection is costly: on Qwen3-VL-32B, the image preprocessing and its scoring pass (the vision encoder and the target up to its reference layer 49) take 15.26 s ( Before in Tab. 9 ), four fifths of the full input’s 19.06 s to the first token, which alone limits its speedup.

For Tab. 9 , the target of each method answers the 190 timing questions again and generates exactly as many tokens as its reasoning and answer in the accuracy run of Tab. 2 , so that its decoding takes as long as in that run.
We decode greedily in one streamed request and do not stop at the end-of-sequence token until this count is reached.
The steps before the target are timed in separate runs on the same questions.
Since the decoding takes most of the time, SkimPrefill gains from generating fewer tokens and from its shorter KV cache.

blocks.en:
This analysis splits the 100 LongDocURL questions of Tab. 2 (10% of the input tokens kept) by how many of their annotated answer pages SkimPrefill keeps: every one for 54 questions, some for 28 and none for 18 (the Missed column of Tab. 5 ).
On LongDocURL, SkimPrefill scores 59.3 against SGP’s 73.8 on Qwen3.5-9B and 62.5 against 73.9 on Qwen3-VL-32B ( Tab. 7 ), and almost all of this gap comes from the 18 questions.
On the 54 questions, both methods score about the same: 78.7 and 80.3 for SkimPrefill on Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3-VL-32B, against 79.9 and 81.0 for SGP.
On the 18 questions, SkimPrefill scores 3.6 and 0.9, and SGP 64.7 and 59.6: SGP keeps a few tokens on almost every page, and so some tokens of an answer page for all 100 questions.
If SkimPrefill matched SGP on these 18 questions, its gap would shrink from 14.5 to 3.5 points on Qwen3.5-9B and from 11.4 to 0.8 on Qwen3-VL-32B.

blocks.en:
On Gemma-4-12B, FlexSelect’s kept tokens spread evenly over the document ( Sec. 5.3 ).
To measure this, we cut each document into ten parts of equal length, from its start to its end, and count how many of the kept tokens fall into each part.
On Gemma-4-12B, every part holds 9.4 to 10.3% of the kept tokens.
On the other two targets, FlexSelect favors one end: on Qwen3.5-9B, the first part holds 19.4% of the kept tokens, and on Qwen3-VL-32B the last part holds 19.4%.

在另外两个目标上,FlexSelect 偏好一端:在Quen3.5-9B上,第一部分持有19.4%的保存符,在Quen3-VL-32B上,最后一部分持有19.4%.

blocks.en:
SGP’s low accuracy on Gemma-4-12B comes mostly from keeping single tokens ( Sec. 5.7 ); its small model, Gemma-4-E2B, is not the cause.
Outside summarization, which the small models’ 64-token answers cut short, Gemma-4-E2B answers fewer questions correctly than Qwen3.5-2B (620 against 834 of the 1,550 questions).
Yet even on these 620 questions, Gemma-4-12B averages 35.3 with SGP, below both the full input (46.7) and SkimPrefill (66.6).
blocks.zh:
SGP在Gemma-4-12B上的低精度大多来自于保留单符(Sec. 5.7);其小型号Gemma-4-E2B并不是原因.
外部的总结(小模型的64-token的答案缩短了时间),Gemma-4-E2B正确回答的问题比Quen3.5-2B(620对1,550个问题中的834个)要少.
然而,即使在这620个问题上,Gemma-4-12B与SGP平均为35.3,低于全部输入(46.7)和SkimPrefill(66.6).

blocks.en: Table 15 : Accuracy per category with the full input and with SkimPrefill at budgets of 5, 10 and 15% (rows 5–15%; selector at half resolution), on the 1,750 test questions. Tokens : mean generated tokens in many-shot ICL; 32K : many-shot ICL answers, of 400, that reach the 32K reasoning limit.
blocks.zh: 表15:在1 750个测试问题上,每类有全部投入和SkimPrefill的准确性,预算为5、10和15%(5-15%;半解析度为选择者)。 Tokens : 在许多shot ICL中平均值生成的符; 32K : 在许多shot ICL中答案,共400个,达到了32K推理极限.

blocks.en: Section 5.5 notes that Gemma-4-12B’s many-shot ICL score falls as the budget grows, and Sec. 5.7 that token-level selection splits the examples apart; the three observations below give the details.
blocks.zh: 第5.5节指出,Gemma-4-12B的多镜头ICL得分随着预算的增长而下降,而Sec.5.7这个符号级别的选择将例子分开;下面的三项观察给出了细节.

blocks.en:
First, Gemma-4-12B scores higher on many-shot ICL the less of the input it reads ( Tab. 15 ): 46.0 with 5% of the tokens, 26.3 with 10%, 18.3 with 15% and 2.8 with the full input.
With more input, its answers grow longer (from 5.0K to 17.3K tokens between 5% and 15%) and more of them reach the 32K limit (from 32 to 184 of 400; 157 with the full input).
The limit does not explain the lower scores, since at every budget the answers that reach it score no worse than the others (59.4 against 44.8 at 5%, 19.0 against 17.6 at 15%).
blocks.zh:
首先,Gemma-4-12B在多镜头ICL上的得分越少其读取的输入数(Tab. 15):46.0与5%的代币,26.3与10%,18.3与15%,2.8与全输入.
随着投入的增加,它的答案会增长更长(从5.0K到17.3K令牌在5%到15%之间),更多的答案会达到32K的极限(从32到184的400;157有完整的输入).
限额不能解释较低的分数,因为在每个预算中,达到限额的答案不会比其他的差(59.4对44.8对5%,19.0对17.6对15%)。

blocks.en:
Second, token-level selection breaks the examples apart.
Each example is an image followed by a label line ( label: N ).
FlexSelect and SGP keep a few tokens of nearly every example image (8.7% and 7.5% of its tokens on average) but few label lines whole (almost none and 35%), whereas SkimPrefill keeps 9.8% of the examples, each image whole together with its label.
A label line counts as kept whole when all its tokens are kept; both measures are averaged within each question and then over the 400 questions.
blocks.zh:
第二,符号级选择将示例分开。
每个例子都是一个图像,后面是标签线(标签:N).
FlexSelect 和 SGP 保存了几条几乎每个实例图像的标志(平均占其标志的8.7%和7.5%),但几乎没有标签线整条(几乎为零和35%),而SkimPrefill 则保留了9.8%的示例,每个图像全条连同其标签.
标记线在保存其所有符号时算得上是整齐的;在每一问题中均匀衡量,然后是400个问题。

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Attention of Gemma-4-12B’s last prompt token to the useful many-shot ICL examples, those whose label is the answer, at each global layer, averaged over the heads and relative to an even spread of the attention over all examples (1: chance); full input, 50 questions.
blocks.zh: 图10:Gemma-4-12B的最后一个即时信号,就是许多有用的ICL实例,这些实例的标签是每个全球层面的答案,它们平均在头部和相对于所有实例的均匀分布(1:机会);全部输入,50个问题。

blocks.en:
Third, FastV and FlexSelect score Gemma-4-12B at layer 5, which may not suit many-shot ICL ( Sec. B.3 ).
FastV takes it as the first layer that attends to the whole input, and FlexSelect picks it with a needle test on MM-NIAH, which rewards finding an inserted image that matches the question.
Many-shot ICL labels its examples with numbers, so the target can find the answer only by matching the image to classify with the examples of its class and reading their label; the needle test does not check whether a layer finds these examples.
On 50 of the 400 questions, we measure how much attention the last prompt token gives these examples at each global layer, relative to an even spread over all examples ( Fig. 10 ).
The ratio stays at chance up to layer 23 and reaches 5.4 and 4.2 only at layers 35 and 41: the target finds the useful examples in its late layers, which FastV and FlexSelect could use only by running most of the target first.
blocks.zh:
第三,FastV和FlexSelect在5层得分Gemma-4-12B,这可能不适合许多镜头的ICL(Sec. B.3 ).
FastV将它作为第一层关注整个输入,FlexSelect在MM-NIAH上用针头测试来选择它,这奖励寻找一个与问题匹配的插入图像.
许多shot的ICL用数字标注其实例,因此目标只能通过匹配图像来与其类示例进行分类并读取其标签来找到答案;针头测试不检查是否有一层找到这些实例.
在400个问题中的50个问题上,我们衡量最后的迅速信号在每一全球层面对这些例子的注意程度,相对于所有例子的均匀分布(图10)。
该比例在第23层上保持偶然,只有第35层和第41层达到5.4和4.2:目标在其后层找到有用的例子,FastV和FlexSelect只能通过先运行大多数目标才能使用.
